ablations: best development prompt at 4096 versus 8192 context
best development prompt at temperature 0.3 versus 0
validation: same complete 30 validation cases: baseline, two strongest nonbaseline development prompts on Qwen2.5, strongest development prompt on Qwen3 4B and Llama3.2 3B; add an ablation only if development evidence warrants it
selection_order: number of violated Correct>=85, Unsupported<=3, mean_latency<=10 targets
final: freeze validation-only selection; run selected configuration on all 100 cases and the original baseline on the same 30 held-out cases. Report held-out separately from exposed development/validation pools.
review: provisional agent-assisted review with exact answer hashes; deterministic technical checks remain separate; no independent human validation
intervals: nominal Wilson 95% intervals conditional on provisional labels; not population guarantees for a nonrandom authored question set

selection_amendment_before_validation.reason: Retain the baseline if a tiny validation change is not a meaningful practical improvement; this is not a statistical significance claim.

screen_latency_caveat: Early development screens overlapped the final model download. Use non-overlapping validation/final runs for latency comparisons.
